quest.title: A Fine Opportunity?
quest.description: Even in the midst of the storm, Cyrus of the Adventurers' Guild seems to be gearing up for action...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x100, Mora x6000, Adventurer's Experience x4, Teyvat Fried Egg x5

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Where has that kid Bennett run off to? *sigh* At a moment like this, no less... I hope he didn't run into any trouble...

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: *hissing* That... hurts...

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Thank you so much. I'd thought that I wouldn't be coming home today...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How are you feeling?

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Ha, it's just a little... *grunt* hurt! Just a little. I'm fine.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: I discovered a group of hilichurls congregating in the camp ahead, and suspected that they might be up to something. So I followed them...

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: ...But I got too close, and they discovered me.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Never mind that, or me — please help to clear those hilichurls out!

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Their numbers are increasing. We can't let their plans come to fruition.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: As for me... I can take care of myself.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: You've cleaned them out, I suppose?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yup.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: You really are very strong. If only I could be as outstanding as you...

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: I, too, would like to leave behind dragon-slaying, world-saving legends, but in the end, I couldn't even beat a pack of hilichurls...

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Ugh... Anyway, I... This is embarrassing, but I have something to ask of you...

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: I actually came to the Thousand Winds Temple because I'm soon to take an Adventure Ranking test...

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: I thought that the ranking would go much more smoothly if I could show my stuff at this time.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: I never thought that I'd not only have nothing to show for it, but almost lose my life in the process as well.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: C—Could I ask you not to tell Cyrus about this? I'd truly be in hot soup if this were to affect my ranking...

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: Thank you so much! I promise I won't be so reckless in future!

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: I know it isn't, and Cyrus always says that adventurers should be honest with themselves...

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: But... *sigh* Forget it. I just hope he wont be too mad at me...

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: You're back, and Jack too. But he's limping...

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: What happened?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Jack rushed in, and got hurt as a result...

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: So it's as I thought. *sigh* He hasn't been listening to what I always tell him, has he?

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: I understand that he wants to prove himself, but...

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Forget it. I understand what happened. I'll talk to Jack.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: This is for you, consider it payment for your adventure.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: You're back, and so is Jack, I see, though he's limping.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: What happened out there?

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: Oh, you fought alongside him? So that's how he was injured.

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: *sigh* Bravery is good... but I'd rather that he were more steady. One can only be an adventurer if one stays alive.

response.speaker: Cyrus
response.text: Your bravery was commendable as well, traveler. Take this as your reward.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
